Change c0367. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. II; 1831 Ch. XIX.

Context before (unchanged): Sometimes I could not prevail on myself to enter my laboratory for several days; and at other times I toiled day and night in order to complete my work.

1818 text: It was indeed a filthy process in which I was engaged. During my first experiment, a kind of enthusiastic frenzy had blinded me to the horror of my employment; my mind was intently fixed on the sequel of my labour, and my eyes were shut to the horror of my proceedings.

1831 text: It was, indeed, a filthy process in which I was engaged. During my first experiment, a kind of enthusiastic frenzy had blinded me to the horror of my employment; my mind was intently fixed on the consummation of my labour, and my eyes were shut to the horror of my proceedings.

Diff: It was {+,+} indeed {+,+} a filthy process in which I was engaged. During my first experiment, a kind of enthusiastic frenzy had blinded me to the horror of my employment; my mind was intently fixed on the [-sequel-] {+consummation+} of my labour, and my eyes were shut to the horror of my proceedings.

Context after (unchanged): But now I went to it in cold blood, and my heart often sickened at the work of my hands.

result.rationale: Commas around "indeed" and the swap of "sequel" for "consummation" are stylistic diction changes; the meaning stays the same, with a slightly more elevated, climactic tone for the goal of his labour.
